d:
Jharkhand men madhyamik aachary abhyarthi apni niyukti ki mang ko lekar mukhyamantri hemant soren se milne pahunche. abhyarthiyon ka kahna hai ki janavri men pariksha aur maee men rijalt jari hone ke bavjud ab tak niyukti ko lekar sthiti spasht nahin hai. aakhir kab tak milega abhyarthiyon ko niyukti patr? mukhyamantri se mulakat ke dauran kya mangen rakhin? dekhie puri riporta.
